recentItems.title: Stars and Stripes editor speaks out after judge okays firing
recentItems.description: Erik Salvin, the editor-in-chief of Stars and Stripes, joins OutFront moments after a judge ruled the Pentagon has the right to fire him.

recentItems.title: Federal judge allows Pentagon to fire three Stars and Stripes journalists
recentItems.description:
A federal judge on Friday ruled that the Pentagon can fire three Stars and Stripes journalists, the latest in a series of blows to press freedoms in the military as the agency has sought to undo the newspaper’s editorial independence.

Editor-in-Chief Erik Slavin speaks with CNN following the ruling.

recentItems.title: Is Trump threatening to sabotage the economy to force Fed rate cuts?
recentItems.description:
President Donald Trump threatened on Friday to prevent the US from trading with many nations unless the Federal Reserve lowers interest rates.

“LOWER THE RATE OR I’LL STOP TRADING WITH COUNTRIES WITH WHICH WE HAVE A DEFICIT, which the U.S. Supreme Court, in its ridiculous and very costly Tariff decision, strongly acknowledged ‘the President’ has an absolute right to do,” Trump said in a post on Truth Social. “IT’S BETTER THAN TARIFFS! The Fed Board, with its great new leader, must get smart - BE PATRIOTS for a change.”

Will the threat work? Does it even make sense? A CNN NewsNight panel debates.

recentItems.title: Epstein survivors allege salon took ‘instructions’ to make them look younger
recentItems.description: Seven Epstein survivors are accusing celebrity hair stylist Frederic Fekkai and his salon of having enabled Epstein’s abuse in a new lawsuit. CNN spoke with two Jane Doe plaintiffs about their experience.

recentItems.title: What caused the deadly Nepal floods?
recentItems.description: Although scientists are still working to determine exactly what caused the floods that tore through the Nepal-China border, climate has become a key contributing factor. CNN’s Bill Weir explains how rising temperatures may lead to the disaster.

recentItems.title: Russia strikes Ukraine Security Service headquarters in central Kyiv
recentItems.description: A Russian drone struck the Kyiv headquarters of Ukraine’s Security Service, the SBU, on Friday, in a rare direct hit on a key government building that highlights Ukraine’s dire shortages of air defenses.

recentItems.title: NASCAR’s Kurt Busch on growing up and racing with brother Kyle
recentItems.description: NASCAR Hall of Famer Kurt Busch remembers decades of racing with his late younger brother Kyle Busch, from their “sibling rivalry” to the bond they shared as they got older. Watch the full conversation at cnn.com/allthereis

recentItems.title: 'Breadcrumbing' is easier than ever
recentItems.description: Dating apps are making it easier than ever to play the field. Audie Cornish and Ari Shapiro break down why that may be the reason the dating scene's so bleak on this week's Engagement Party podcast.
